_comment: Semgrep scan policy for this node line (contrib/semgrep/README.md). Identical in ycash-dd and ycash6.

rule_sources.name: semgrep-rules
rule_sources.license: Semgrep Rules License v1.0: free, for our own use; fetched at scan time, never copied in, never quoted in PRs

exclude_rules.rust.lang.security.unsafe-usage: Every `unsafe` block in src/rust is the C++/Rust FFI boundary by design; the audit rule flags each one (191 hits, INFO) and would bury real findings.

audit_rules.0xdea.rules.c.raptor-typos: Spelling-level C idioms (e.g. '=' vs '=='); -Wall already warns; 1,800+ hits per node repo
audit_rules.0xdea.rules.c.raptor-interesting-api-cal: Lists every call to memory/string APIs as a starting point for manual review; 900+ hits
audit_rules.0xdea.rules.c.raptor-signed-unsigned-con: Every signed/unsigned mix; 700+ hits, nearly all intended
audit_rules.0xdea.rules.c.raptor-suspicious-assert: Every assert() with a side-effect-looking argument; 100+ hits in upstream Bitcoin/Zcash code
audit_rules.0xdea.rules.c.raptor-high-entropy-assign: Hard-coded constants (hash IVs, test vectors) look like secrets
audit_rules.0xdea.rules.c.raptor-use-of-source-size-: memcpy sized by the source; all 55 hits checked 2026-10-22 and correct (fixed arrays, bounded hash buffers)
audit_rules.0xdea.rules.c.raptor-pointer-subtraction: Every pointer difference; idiomatic in prevector/serialize
audit_rules.0xdea.rules.c.raptor-integer-truncation: Every narrowing assignment; review lead only
audit_rules.0xdea.rules.c.raptor-write-into-stack-bu: Every write into a local array; review lead only
audit_rules.0xdea.rules.c.raptor-missing-return: The compiler already errors on it (-Werror=return-type)
audit_rules.0xdea.rules.c.raptor-mismatched-memory-m: Every new/delete/malloc pairing in C++; review lead only
